test: completing a task updates the counter and the Done filter
rationale: The diff shows app/page.tsx changed the input's aria-label from "New task" to "Task title", while the test still does page.getByLabel("New task").fill(...). The failure is a deterministic 30s timeout on locator.fill in both the initial attempt and the retry, which rules out flake (no pass on retry) and points to a stale selector rather than a product regression — the app's behavior is intact, only the accessible name the test targets has drifted.
recommendedAction: Update the test to use the new accessible name, e.g. page.getByLabel("Task title").fill("Ship the demo") (or better, add a stable data-testid to the input and target that), then re-run the spec.
